parameters.subject: Why your watermark is failing. (Behind the tech)
parameters.html:
A lot of creators ask us why standard watermarks don't work anymore.

Here is the ugly truth we see on the dark web every day: Scraping bots use basic computer vision to strip watermarks from your Pay-Per-View content in roughly 0.4 seconds.

It takes us 3 seconds to hunt that source file down and execute a legally binding DMCA takedown to nuke it permanently.

Don't fight bots with humans. We are almost ready for launch.

parameters.subject: The $150k Leak.
parameters.html:
Last week, we ran a test scrape on a private Telegram group. We found a single $15 PPV video that had been shared over 10,000 times.

That creator lost $150,000 in potential LTV overnight because their manual DMCA lawyer was asleep.

As a Tuppli Founder, you won't have to worry about this. Our 'Legal Enforcer' bots never sleep.

Launch is approaching. Make sure your billing details are ready when we open the gates.
